005package org.wpilib.driverstation;
006
007import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
008
009import java.math.BigDecimal;
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
012import java.util.List;
013import java.util.Map;
014import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
015
016/**
017 * A set of selectable options controlled by a {@link Gamepad}.
018 *
019 * <p>The D-pad up and down buttons select which selectable is active. The D-pad left and right
020 * buttons change the selected option in the active selectable.
021 */
022public class DSGamepadChooser {
023  private static final AtomicInteger s_instances = new AtomicInteger();
024
025  private final Gamepad m_gamepad;
026  private final List<GamepadSelectable> m_selectables = new ArrayList<>();
027  private final Map<String, GamepadSelectable> m_selectableMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
028  private final String m_captionPrefix;
029  private int m_selectedSelectable;
030
031  /**
032   * Constructs a DSGamepadChooser.
033   *
034   * @param port The port index on the Driver Station that the gamepad is plugged into (0-5).
035   */
036  public DSGamepadChooser(int port) {
037    this(DriverStation.getGamepad(port));
038  }
039
040  /**
041   * Constructs a DSGamepadChooser.
042   *
043   * @param gamepad The gamepad used to change selections.
044   */
045  public DSGamepadChooser(Gamepad gamepad) {
046    m_gamepad = requireNonNullParam(gamepad, "gamepad", "DSGamepadChooser");
047    m_captionPrefix = "DSGamepadChooser/" + s_instances.getAndIncrement() + "/";
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Get the gamepad used to change selections.
052   *
053   * @return the gamepad
054   */
055  public Gamepad getGamepad() {
056    return m_gamepad;
057  }
058
059  /**
060   * Adds a selectable with the given options.
061   *
062   * <p>The first option is selected by default.
063   *
064   * @param name selectable name
065   * @param options available options
066   * @return the created selectable
067   */
068  public GamepadSelectable addOptions(String name, List<String> options) {
069    requireSelectableName(name, "addOptions");
070    requireNonNullParam(options, "options", "addOptions");
071    if (options.isEmpty()) {
072      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Options cannot be empty");
073    }
074    if (m_selectableMap.containsKey(name)) {
075      throw new IllegalArgumentException("GamepadSelectable already exists: " + name);
076    }
077
078    var selectable = new GamepadSelectable(name, options);
079    m_selectables.add(selectable);
080    m_selectableMap.put(name, selectable);
081    return selectable;
082  }
083
084  /**
085   * Adds a selectable with the given options.
086   *
087   * <p>The first option is selected by default.
088   *
089   * @param name selectable name
090   * @param options available options
091   * @return the created selectable
092   */
093  public GamepadSelectable addOptions(String name, String... options) {
094    requireSelectableName(name, "addOptions");
095    requireNonNullParam(options, "options", "addOptions");
096    if (options.length == 0) {
097      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Options cannot be empty");
098    }
099    if (m_selectableMap.containsKey(name)) {
100      throw new IllegalArgumentException("GamepadSelectable already exists: " + name);
101    }
102
103    var selectable = new GamepadSelectable(name, options);
104    m_selectables.add(selectable);
105    m_selectableMap.put(name, selectable);
106    return selectable;
107  }
108
109  /**
110   * Adds a selectable with integer options from {@code min} to {@code max}, inclusive, stepping by
111   * {@code delta}.
112   *
113   * <p>The first option is selected by default.
114   *
115   * @param name selectable name
116   * @param min minimum option
117   * @param max maximum option
118   * @param delta amount between options
119   * @return the created selectable
120   */
121  public GamepadSelectable addIntegerOptions(String name, int min, int max, int delta) {
122    if (min > max) {
123      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Minimum cannot be greater than maximum");
124    }
125    if (delta <= 0) {
126      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Delta must be greater than zero");
127    }
128
129    List<String> options = new ArrayList<>();
130    for (long value = min; value <= max; value += delta) {
131      options.add(String.valueOf(value));
132    }
133    if (!options.get(options.size() - 1).equals(String.valueOf(max))) {
134      options.add(String.valueOf(max));
135    }
136    return addOptions(name, options);
137  }
138
139  /**
140   * Adds a selectable with floating point options from {@code min} to {@code max}, inclusive,
141   * stepping by {@code delta}.
142   *
143   * <p>The first option is selected by default.
144   *
145   * @param name selectable name
146   * @param min minimum option
147   * @param max maximum option
148   * @param delta amount between options
149   * @return the created selectable
150   */
151  public GamepadSelectable addDoubleOptions(String name, double min, double max, double delta) {
152    if (!Double.isFinite(min) || !Double.isFinite(max) || !Double.isFinite(delta)) {
153      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Minimum, maximum, and delta must be finite");
154    }
155    if (min > max) {
156      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Minimum cannot be greater than maximum");
157    }
158    if (delta <= 0.0) {
159      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Delta must be greater than zero");
160    }
161
162    BigDecimal value = BigDecimal.valueOf(min);
163    BigDecimal maximum = BigDecimal.valueOf(max);
164    BigDecimal increment = BigDecimal.valueOf(delta);
165    List<String> options = new ArrayList<>();
166    BigDecimal lastValue = value;
167    while (value.compareTo(maximum) <= 0) {
168      options.add(value.toPlainString());
169      lastValue = value;
170      value = value.add(increment);
171    }
172    String maximumString = maximum.toPlainString();
173    if (lastValue.compareTo(maximum) != 0) {
174      options.add(maximumString);
175    }
176    return addOptions(name, options);
177  }
178
179  /**
180   * Updates selectable selection and adds the current selections to the driver station display.
181   *
182   * <p>The D-pad up and down buttons select which selectable is active. The D-pad left and right
183   * buttons change the selected option in the active selectable.
184   *
185   * <p>Call {@link DriverStationDisplay#updateLines()} externally to flush display updates.
186   */
187  public void update() {
188    if (m_selectables.isEmpty()) {
189      return;
190    }
191
192    if (m_gamepad.getDpadUpButtonPressed()) {
193      m_selectedSelectable = wrap(m_selectedSelectable - 1, m_selectables.size());
194    }
195    if (m_gamepad.getDpadDownButtonPressed()) {
196      m_selectedSelectable = wrap(m_selectedSelectable + 1, m_selectables.size());
197    }
198
199    GamepadSelectable selectable = m_selectables.get(m_selectedSelectable);
200    if (m_gamepad.getDpadLeftButtonPressed()) {
201      selectable.selectPrevious();
202    }
203    if (m_gamepad.getDpadRightButtonPressed()) {
204      selectable.selectNext();
205    }
206
207    for (int i = 0; i < m_selectables.size(); i++) {
208      GamepadSelectable displaySelectable = m_selectables.get(i);
209      DriverStationDisplay.addKeyedLine(
210          m_captionPrefix + displaySelectable.getName(),
211          formatDisplayLine(displaySelectable, i == m_selectedSelectable));
212    }
213  }
214
215  /**
216   * Gets the currently selected option for a selectable.
217   *
218   * @param name selectable name
219   * @return the currently selected option
220   */
221  public String getSelected(String name) {
222    return getSelectable(name).getSelected();
223  }
224
225  /**
226   * Gets the currently selected integer option for a selectable.
227   *
228   * @param name selectable name
229   * @return the currently selected option
230   */
231  public int getSelectedInteger(String name) {
232    return Integer.parseInt(getSelected(name));
233  }
234
235  /**
236   * Gets the currently selected double option for a selectable.
237   *
238   * @param name selectable name
239   * @return the currently selected option
240   */
241  public double getSelectedDouble(String name) {
242    return Double.parseDouble(getSelected(name));
243  }
244
245  /**
246   * Gets the currently selected option index for a selectable.
247   *
248   * @param name selectable name
249   * @return the currently selected option index
250   */
251  public int getSelectedIndex(String name) {
252    return getSelectable(name).getSelectedIndex();
253  }
254
255  /**
256   * Gets the names of all selectables.
257   *
258   * @return selectable names
259   */
260  public List<String> getSelectableNames() {
261    return List.copyOf(m_selectableMap.keySet());
262  }
263
264  /**
265   * Gets the selectable currently controlled by D-pad left and right.
266   *
267   * @return the selected selectable
268   */
269  public GamepadSelectable getSelectedSelectable() {
270    if (m_selectables.isEmpty()) {
271      return null;
272    }
273    return m_selectables.get(m_selectedSelectable);
274  }
275
276  private GamepadSelectable getSelectable(String name) {
277    requireSelectableName(name, "getSelectable");
278    GamepadSelectable selectable = m_selectableMap.get(name);
279    if (selectable == null) {
280      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown selectable: " + name);
281    }
282    return selectable;
283  }
284
285  private static void requireSelectableName(String name, String methodName) {
286    requireNonNullParam(name, "name", methodName);
287    if (name.isBlank()) {
288      throw new IllegalArgumentException("GamepadSelectable name cannot be blank");
289    }
290  }
291
292  private static int wrap(int value, int size) {
293    return Math.floorMod(value, size);
294  }
295
296  private static String formatDisplayLine(GamepadSelectable selectable, boolean selected) {
297    if (selected) {
298      return "> " + selectable.getName() + " : " + selectable.getSelected() + " <";
299    }
300    return "  " + selectable.getName() + " : " + selectable.getSelected();
301  }
302
303  /** A single named set of selectable options. */
304  public static final class GamepadSelectable {
305    private final String m_name;
306    private final List<String> m_options;
307    private int m_selectedIndex;
308
309    private GamepadSelectable(String name, String[] options) {
310      m_name = name;
311      m_options = List.of(options);
312    }
313
314    private GamepadSelectable(String name, List<String> options) {
315      m_name = name;
316      m_options = List.copyOf(options);
317    }
318
319    /**
320     * Gets the selectable name.
321     *
322     * @return selectable name
323     */
324    public String getName() {
325      return m_name;
326    }
327
328    /**
329     * Gets the available options.
330     *
331     * @return available options
332     */
333    public List<String> getOptions() {
334      return m_options;
335    }
336
337    /**
338     * Gets the currently selected option.
339     *
340     * @return the currently selected option
341     */
342    public String getSelected() {
343      return m_options.get(m_selectedIndex);
344    }
345
346    /**
347     * Gets the currently selected option index.
348     *
349     * @return the currently selected option index
350     */
351    public int getSelectedIndex() {
352      return m_selectedIndex;
353    }
354
355    private void selectPrevious() {
356      m_selectedIndex = wrap(m_selectedIndex - 1, m_options.size());
357    }
358
359    private void selectNext() {
360      m_selectedIndex = wrap(m_selectedIndex + 1, m_options.size());
361    }
362  }
363}
